dedupe_keys.name: iea ebc annex 80 typical and extreme weather datasets for studying the resilience of buildings to climate change

description: These weather files were made by the weather data group of IEA EBC Annex 80, Resilient Cooling for Buildings, so that building simulations can test resilience to heat under a changing climate. They cover 15 cities in ten climate zones and give hourly air temperature, humidity, pressure, direct and diffuse solar radiation and wind speed. For each city there are typical years and heatwave years in EnergyPlus weather format and multi-year series in CSV, for 2001-2020, 2041-2060 and 2081-2100, built from the MPI-RCA4 regional climate model and bias-corrected against observations. Coverage: 15 cities worldwide. Access: free from the World Data Center for Climate under a DOI; the generation code is on Zenodo. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: one regional climate model chain, so model spread is not sampled; a correction to the data descriptor was published in 2025. Simulation uses are overheating and cooling resilience tests of buildings under current and future heatwaves, and design weather for adaptation studies. Related records: EnergyPlus, Meteonorm typical and future weather, and ASHRAE climatic design conditions.
